environmentDescription: Sunlit Rajshahi mango orchard courtyard with terracotta garden walls, a tall split-bamboo mango chute on the left, and a shady banyan-branch gazebo exit on the right.
rescueStory: Mochi climbed into the orchard sorting loft to taste ripe Himsagar mangoes, accidentally tripping the bamboo harvest latch as the Emerald Serpent slithers up the irrigation trench!

mainObjective.summary: Break 6 Woven Bamboo Cages and drain 50 Golden Mango Marbles to lift the loft counter-gate.

secondaryObjective.summary: Collect 24 Himsagar Mango Drops to pack Mochi's picnic basket for +1 Bonus Star.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color fruit board (Mango, Litchi, Guava, Coconut, Jamun); matching 4+ Mango Drops coats drain chutes in slick nectar for 2x marble flow.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 6 2-HP Bamboo Cages staggered in a staircase across columns 0–2 directly under the mango silo.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Slithers along an S-curved terracotta orchard wall channel at steady onboarding speed (1.7%/sec).

specialMechanics: Mango Nectar Slick: every 4-in-a-row of Himsagar Mango Drops lubricates the bamboo chute for 5 seconds, doubling marble release per match.
victoryCondition: All 6 Bamboo Cages broken and all 50 Mango Marbles drained before Danger reaches 100%.
failureCondition: Emerald Serpent reaches Mochi's sorting loft (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: First introduction of Nectar-lubricated drain columns where 4-matches temporarily double physical marble gravity speed.

environmentDescription: High orchard canopy walkway built from four crispy tea-biscuit ledges suspended between mango boughs above a soft hay cart far below.
rescueStory: Hungry Golla-Gulp has perched beside the canopy walkway, shaking the branches so the crispy wafer ledges beneath Mochi begin cracking one by one!

mainObjective.summary: Collect 30 Guava Crisps and 20 Jackfruit Pods to hop Mochi across all 4 Crumbling Biscuit Platforms before they drop.

secondaryObjective.summary: Trick Golla-Gulp into swallowing 2 Striped or Wrapped candies for a fizzy hiccup bonus.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color fruit board including Madhupur Jackfruit; players must race Golla-Gulp for green Guava clusters or bait its tongue reticle with Special Candies.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Each of Mochi's 4 upper ledges cracks over 3 player moves unless Mochi advances to the next ledge.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Every 3 moves, marks 3 Guava candies on the board and slurps them away unless matched first or replaced with a Special Candy.

specialMechanics: Bait-and-Fizzy Counter: sliding a Striped or Wrapped candy onto Golla-Gulp's fork-and-spoon reticle causes it to hiccup +6 Guava candies back onto the board!
victoryCondition: Complete both fruit quotas within 28 moves while keeping an intact Biscuit Platform beneath Mochi.
failureCondition: Mochi's current Biscuit Platform hits 0 stability (3 turns without advancing) or 28 moves expire.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Turn-based platform decay coupled with an enemy that competes for your exact target candy color on the grid.

environmentDescription: A sunlit irrigation canal cutting through red-earth mango groves, spanned by an overhead bamboo beam rigged with golden Bengal jute ropes.
rescueStory: A summer gust washed out the middle footbridge over Nectar Creek while the Emerald Serpent swims upstream toward Mochi's bank!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 2 Orchard Pulley Keys and break 8 Bamboo Cages to rig Mochi's overhead jute zip-swing across the creek.

secondaryObjective.summary: Create 3 Wrapped Candies (2x2 or L-shape) to weave bonus rope knots.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Jackfruit L/T matches deal +1 bonus damage to adjacent 2-HP Bamboo Cages blocking the Key chutes.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Columns 2 and 5 hold Pulley Keys guarded by 2-HP Bamboo Cages at row 4 and Chained candies at row 5.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Swims up the creek bank channel at 1.85%/sec.

specialMechanics: Two-Stage Zip-Line: the first Pulley Key swings Mochi to a mid-stream boulder island (+15% safety distance from the serpent); the second swings her to the exit gazebo!
victoryCondition: Drop both Pulley Keys and clear all 8 Bamboo Cages before the Serpent reaches Mochi's current bank.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100% before Mochi swings clear.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Mid-mission positional checkpoint: dropping Key #1 physically relocates Mochi halfway across the river, dynamically resetting enemy proximity by 20%.

environmentDescription: An old brick mango-ripening storehouse with carved terracotta ventilation sliders and glowing brass skylights.
rescueStory: Mochi is locked inside the storehouse courtyard behind heavy sliding terracotta vents that shift left and right with every move!

mainObjective.summary: Guide 3 Brass Courtyard Keys past the Moving Terracotta Partitions to the bottom exit slots.

secondaryObjective.summary: Clean 8 Sticky Tree-Sap tiles before they spread.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board including Tender Coconut; Coconut Wrapped combos wash sap off 2 neighboring tiles.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Two indestructible 2-cell Terracotta Sliders on rows 2 and 4 oscillate 1 column horizontally after each turn.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Prowls along the courtyard parapet in hybrid turn-plus-slow-drift mode.

specialMechanics: Oscillating Chute Alignment: Keys can only drop past rows 2 and 4 on turns when the Terracotta Slider shifts clear of their column!
victoryCondition: Drop all 3 Brass Courtyard Keys before 26 moves or 100% Serpent danger.
failureCondition: Out of moves or Serpent reaches parapet drop-point.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Rhythmic horizontal sliding dividers on the Match-3 grid require looking 1 move ahead before pulling a Key downward.

environmentDescription: Grand Rajshahi orchard amphitheater where twin wooden mango-cart ramps converge toward a golden harvest pavilion.
rescueStory: Both the Emerald Serpent AND hungry Golla-Gulp corner Mochi at the harvest pavilion while a giant mango-barrel rolls down the upper ramp!

mainObjective.summary: Drain 65 Mango Marbles, break 8 Bamboo Cages, and trigger 4 Special Candies to raise the Pavilion Drawbridge.

secondaryObjective.summary: Finish with Danger below 55% to earn the Chapter 1 Golden Mango Trophy.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color fruit board with high cascade density; matching 5 creates Rainbow Bombs that stun both enemies simultaneously.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Crumbling Biscuit Ledge holds Mochi while Bamboo Cages frame a diamond island in the center of the board.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Golla-Gulp steals Mango Drops on the board while a Spiked Barrel-Boulder rolls down the ramp at 1.95%/sec.

specialMechanics: Dual-Threat Synergy: feeding Golla-Gulp a fizzy Special Candy causes it to sneeze a gust that pushes the rolling Barrel-Boulder uphill by 18%!
victoryCondition: Complete all 3 harvest drawbridge tasks before the rolling barrel reaches Mochi.
failureCondition: Barrel impact or crumbling ledge failure.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Using one enemy to counter another: fizzy-stunning Golla-Gulp physically knocks back the arena boulder hazard!

environmentDescription: Emerald hillside tea terraces in Sylhet wrapped in silvery dawn mist, with a wooden pluckers' footbridge leading to a cozy tea bungalow.
rescueStory: Cool highland fog rolled across the tea terraces just as Mochi stepped onto a swaying rope bridge—she needs clear sightlines to cross safely!

mainObjective.summary: Dispel 12 Tea Mist Clouds and collect 32 Darjeeling Mandarin segments to repair the 4 Rope Bridge slats.

secondaryObjective.summary: Complete with 8+ moves remaining for +150 bonus coins.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board introducing `CANDY_DARJEELING_ORANGE`; Mandarin matches emit a citrus zest ring that clears Mist in a 3x3 halo!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 12 Mist Clouds veil the central 4x3 region; unique 3D candy silhouettes peek subtly through the mist.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Gentle breather pace: advances 1 step only every move (move-linked) along the lower tea hedge.

specialMechanics: Silhouette Recognition & Zest Reveal: players can still swap misted candies by reading their 3D silhouettes, and Mandarin matches burst fog across neighbors!
victoryCondition: All 12 Mist Clouds cleared and 4 Rope Bridge slats rebuilt within 30 moves.
failureCondition: Moves exhausted before Mochi crosses the footbridge.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Post-climax relief breather where 3D candy shape silhouettes let observant players make matches right inside fog banks!

environmentDescription: A timber hillside irrigation mill featuring giant teakwood paddle waterwheels and brass sorting chutes.
rescueStory: A Brass Clockwork Automaton patrolling the tea mill mistook Mochi for an unweighed tea sack—she must slip through the Rotating Waterwheel Gates!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 2 Mill-Wheel Keys and snap 8 Wrought Metal Chains while syncing with the Rotating Gates.

secondaryObjective.summary: Overwind-stun the Brass Clockwork Automaton twice using vertical Striped blasts.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; vertical Striped blasts aligned with the Automaton's column stall its march for 2 moves.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Two Rotating Waterwheel Gates at (3,2) and (3,5) flip 90 degrees each turn between horizontal-open and vertical-drop-open.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Turn-based march (0 real-time stress!): advances 1 node per move and chains 2 tiles every 4th move.

specialMechanics: Turnstile Cadence: Keys above the Waterwheel Gates can only drop through on EVEN moves when the paddles align vertically!
victoryCondition: Drop both Mill-Wheel Keys and clear 8 Chains before the Automaton completes its 27-step patrol.
failureCondition: Automaton reaches Mochi's platform on move 27.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Zero real-time clock—100% pure turn-based clockwork puzzle where every gate and enemy ticks only when you swipe!

environmentDescription: Elevated split-bamboo water flumes crisscrossing a breezy green canyon between two Sylhet hills.
rescueStory: Strong canyon winds are blowing Mochi's leaf-raft backward toward a waterfall drop while mist obscures the flume valves!

mainObjective.summary: Drain 55 Flume Marbles and match 28 Guava Crisps to sail Mochi's leaf-raft upstream to the stone dock.

secondaryObjective.summary: Trigger 5 automatic cascade matches caused by the Wind Tunnel's sideways drift.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; rows 2 and 3 are swept rightward 1 cell after every move by `OBS_GALE_WIND_TUNNEL`.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Rows 2–3 slide 1 tile right (wrapping around!) after each cascade settles.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Pursues along the parallel bamboo aqueduct at 1.8%/sec.

specialMechanics: Conveyor Cascade Surfing: planning swaps so the end-of-turn 1-cell wind shift lines up 4 or 5 candies automatically awards +2x raft boost!
victoryCondition: Reach 100% dock propulsion and drain 55 Flume Marbles before waterfall/Serpent catch.
failureCondition: Wind pushes leaf-raft to 100% danger brink.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Wrap-around sideways wind conveyor on rows 2–3 turns environmental drift into an intentional combo-building engine.

environmentDescription: Steep double-tiered tea garden staircase where two stone sluice channels race downward toward a central pavilion.
rescueStory: Mochi is descending the central garden steps while BOTH a Clockwork Automaton on the left wall and an Emerald Serpent in the right sluice race to block the bottom gate!

mainObjective.summary: Break 10 Glacier Ice seals, clear 8 Mist Clouds, and detonate 4 Special Candies to open both terrace gates.

secondaryObjective.summary: Craft 1 Rainbow Color Bomb to clear an entire fruit terrace at once.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board divided into Left & Right 4-column wings separated by a Rotating Waterwheel in the middle.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Left wing counters the turn-based Automaton; right wing counters the real-time Serpent!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Hybrid dual-enemy pressure: Left lane advances per move; Right lane advances slowly over time (1.45%/sec)!

specialMechanics: Split-Wing Attention: matches on columns 0–3 push back the Automaton, while matches on columns 4–7 push back the Serpent!
victoryCondition: Clear all Ice, Mist, and Special quotas before either lane's pursuer locks the bottom gate.
failureCondition: Left Automaton reaches step 26 OR Right Serpent hits 100% danger.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Asymmetric Left-vs-Right board hemispheres—left matches manage turn-based danger while right matches manage real-time danger!

environmentDescription: Grand Sylhet Watermill Reservoir with twin cascading waterfalls, giant spinning timber waterwheels, and a golden cable-car escape station.
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 1! The giant Mist-Coiled Serpent Matriarch wraps around the main reservoir wheel, blanketing the board in highland fog while blocking Mochi's cable car!

mainObjective.summary: Deplete the Matriarch's 120 HP shield by clearing Mist, dropping 2 Brass Tea-Chest Keys, and draining 45 Reservoir Marbles.

secondaryObjective.summary: Defeat the Matriarch without letting Mochi's cable car take slime damage.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board featuring Mandarin Oranges; clearing Mist exposes glowing Weak-Point Bells on row 0 that deal 25 Boss damage when hit by vertical Striped blasts!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Phase 1 spawns 3x3 Mist veils; Phase 2 toggles Waterwheel Gates and spits Sap onto drain columns.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Boss advancing at 1.5%/sec with periodic Mist Breath (every 9s) and Sap Spit.

specialMechanics: Waterwheel Splashdown Finisher: once both Keys unlock the reservoir wheel and Boss HP hits 0, a giant sparkling wave washes the Matriarch harmlessly down the flume!
victoryCondition: Reduce Boss HP to 0, drop 2 Keys, and drain 45 Marbles before cable-car danger hits 100%.
failureCondition: Matriarch coils around the cable car (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: Two-phase boss puzzle where dispelling fog reveals physical overhead Bell targets that can be sniped by vertical Striped candies!

environmentDescription: Dappled emerald sunlight filtering through Sundarbans mangrove arches onto a wooden stilt boardwalk bordered by comical bubbling chocolate-brown silt puddles.
rescueStory: After escaping the highlands, Mochi lands on a Sundarbans nature boardwalk—where playful bubbling mud bogs threaten to glue her boots in place!

mainObjective.summary: Clear 10 Bubbling Mud Bog tiles and collect 30 Tender Coconut cubes to lay clean palm-mat walkways for Mochi.

secondaryObjective.summary: Create 2 Mango 4-matches to give Mochi a sprint boost.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board (Coconut, Mango, Jackfruit, Guava, Jamun); Coconut matches splash clean water onto adjacent 2-HP Mud Bog cells.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 10 poison-free Mud Bog puddles along rows 4–6; if an item falls onto mud without clearing it, it sticks for 1 turn.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Relaxed Chapter-opener pursuit through mangrove roots (move-linked, 30 moves).

specialMechanics: Clean Splash Chain: popping a Wrapped Coconut candy washes away all Mud Bog puddles in a 3x3 zone in a single move!
victoryCondition: Wash away all 10 Mud Bog tiles and collect 30 Coconut cubes within 30 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out while Mochi is still mired on the boardwalk.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Relaxing post-boss breather introducing poison-free sticky silt puddles that reward splash-radius Coconut combos.

environmentDescription: A timber forest-ranger watchtower connected by checkered sandstone causeways fitted with alternating bamboo thorn-pegs.
rescueStory: A wiggly Gur-Slime Blob is oozing down the watchtower ramp! Mochi must sprint across the causeway ONLY on safe even beats when the bamboo pegs retract!

mainObjective.summary: Clear 10 Sticky Slime coatings and collect 36 Guava Crisps to advance Mochi across 4 Retractable Thorn Checkpoints.

secondaryObjective.summary: Defeat or shrink the Slime Blob without splitting it with dry bombs.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; avoid hitting `ENEMY_SYRUP_OOZE_BLOB` projections with dry Jilapi Bombs (use Coconut/Water matches instead!).

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Causeway pegs toggle UP (odd moves) and DOWN (even moves). Completing a 9-Guava checkpoint on an odd move holds Mochi safely at the curb until the next even beat!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Coats 2 candies in Slime every 3 moves; splits into faster twins if hit by dry explosives.

specialMechanics: Even-Beat Safe Crossing: completing a Guava threshold ON an even move grants an instant 'Perfect Stride!' leap (+10% distance bonus)!
victoryCondition: Clear 10 Slimes and reach Watchtower Door within 28 moves.
failureCondition: Slime Blob overtakes Mochi on the causeway.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Odd/Even move rhythm bonus rewards counting turns before completing each 9-Guava movement threshold!

environmentDescription: Overhanging Sundarbans branches heavy with giant shimmering golden wild-honeycombs above a turquoise tidal creek.
rescueStory: A Tangle-Vine Stilt Crawler has woven wooden cages around Mochi's dinghy rope while giant Golden Honeycombs seal the center of the puzzle board!

mainObjective.summary: Shatter 3 Queen Honeycomb Clusters and drop 2 Dinghy Oar Keys to untie Mochi's boat.

secondaryObjective.summary: Land 3 Jackfruit L/T matches to knock back the Stilt Crawler's wooden legs.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board featuring Madhupur Jackfruit; peripheral Honeycomb cells regenerate unless players snipe the glowing central Queen Cell of each 5-tile hex cluster!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Three 5-cell Honeycomb clusters at top-left, center, and top-right; cracking the center cell shatters all 4 petals instantly!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Strides across the creek at 1.75%/sec and cages 1 bottom-row tile every 12s.

specialMechanics: Queen-Cell Target Priority: striking the glowing central wax cell causes a chain-pop that clears all linked wax petals AND releases sweet honey that slows the Stilt Crawler by 25%!
victoryCondition: Shatter all 3 Honeycomb clusters and drop both Oar Keys before the Stilt Crawler pins the boat.
failureCondition: Danger hits 100% before dinghy launch.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Regenerating hex-clusters that collapse instantaneously when you snipe their glowing central Queen node!

environmentDescription: Intersecting mangrove root tunnels where rising and ebbing brackish creek water shifts floating driftwood bridges.
rescueStory: Mochi is navigating a forked mangrove tunnel where a Stilt Crawler blocks the high path and a Slime Blob oozes up the low path!

mainObjective.summary: Drain 60 Creek Marbles, clear 8 Mud Bogs, and break 6 Iron Chains to open the high-canopy root bridge.

secondaryObjective.summary: Win with at least 2 Special Candies still gleaming on the board for bonus fireworks.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Chained Special Candies sit pre-placed in the center waiting to be unlocked.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 4 Chained Striped Candies in row 3 unlock massive cross-clears once freed.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances at 1.9%/sec while Mud Bogs halve Mochi's gate-opening speed until cleaned.

specialMechanics: Mud-Friction Coupling: as long as >4 Mud Bog tiles remain on the board, the counterweight gate rises at 50% speed—cleaning the mud first restores 100% winch speed!
victoryCondition: Clean Mud Bogs, free Chains, and drain 60 Marbles before capture.
failureCondition: Stilt Crawler reaches Mochi's fork chamber.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Order-of-operations puzzle: clearing Mud Bogs FIRST doubles the mechanical efficiency of all subsequent marble-draining matches!

environmentDescription: A quiet emerald lagoon at the edge of the Sundarbans where three ornate Brass Sweet Trunks rest on sandy shoals beside a waiting sailboat.
rescueStory: Mochi's sailboat rudder, sail-pin, and compass are locked inside three Brass Sweet Trunks—each sealed with three color-coded fruit gem clasps!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock all 3 Brass Treasure Trunks (9 color-coded gem clasps total) and clear 2 Honeycomb Seals to launch the sailboat.

secondaryObjective.summary: Launch the sailboat within 20 moves for 3 Stars.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; each Brass Trunk displays 3 glowing fruit icons (e.g. Mango + Coconut + Jamun)—matching that fruit anywhere in the Trunk's row or column pops 1 clasp!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Trunks sit at (2,1), (4,4), and (2,6), immune to raw bomb damage—only aligned color matches pop their clasps!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Circles the lagoon shoal in hybrid turn-plus-tide mode (26 moves / 75s).

specialMechanics: Line-of-Sight Color Unlocking: matching the required fruit color in the same row OR column as a Brass Trunk shoots a laser-key beam straight into its matching clasp!
victoryCondition: Pop all 3 Brass Trunks and clear both Honeycombs to sail away.
failureCondition: 26 moves exhausted or lagoon Danger hits 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Hammer-immune color-combination locks that require aligning specific fruit colors along orthogonal sightlines!

environmentDescription: Sun-dappled crimson litchi treehouses in Dinajpur connected by bamboo zip-platforms above sizzling jaggery-boiling pans.
rescueStory: A Sizzling Caramel Salamander is scampering along the treehouse ropes, dropping hot sugar sparks that threaten to singe Mochi's ladder!

mainObjective.summary: Extinguish 10 Spiced Sugar Fire Barriers and harvest 35 Ruby Litchis to raise the treehouse rope ladder.

secondaryObjective.summary: Match 9 Pistachio Kulfi or Coconut pieces to cool the Salamander's tail.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board introducing `OBS_CHILI_EMBER_FIRE` alongside Jamun & Coconut cooling fruits.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 6 initial Fire rings on row 4; if zero fire tiles are cleared on any move, 1 new fire spark hops to an adjacent tile.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Gentle Chapter-4 onboarding pace (29 moves); drops 1 fresh ember every 3 moves.

specialMechanics: Containment Rule: clearing at least 1 Fire Barrier on a turn completely prevents ALL remaining Fire Barriers from spreading that turn!
victoryCondition: Extinguish 10 Fire Barriers and collect 35 Ruby Litchis within 29 moves.
failureCondition: Fire Barriers spread to >16 tiles or moves reach 0.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Classic Candy-Crush-Chocolate containment cadence: dousing just 1 ember per turn freezes the entire fire network's expansion!

environmentDescription: Open treetop sorting deck strung with colourful fluttering orchard pennants and pulley baskets.
rescueStory: Two mischievous Canopy Gliders are swooping over the sorting deck trying to snatch Mochi's Treehouse Keys right off the puzzle board!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 3 Treehouse Pulley Keys to the bottom row before the Canopy Gliders lift them back to the top!

secondaryObjective.summary: Disrupt 3 Glider swoop shadows by matching directly inside their target circles.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; vertical Litchi matches charge +20% bonus pulley pull.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Keys start at row 1 in cols 1, 4, 6; Glider shadow reticles lock onto a Key for 2 moves before lifting it 2 rows UP.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Swoops every 2 moves to hoist unguarded Keys upward while the Emerald Serpent climbs the trunk (1.65%/sec).

specialMechanics: Shadow-Reticle Counterplay: matching any 3 candies touching a Glider's shadow startles the Glider into dropping a bonus Striped Candy!
victoryCondition: Deliver all 3 Treehouse Keys to row 6 before the Serpent climbs the trunk.
failureCondition: Trunk Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Vertical tug-of-war where aerial thieves pull your Keys UPWARD if you ignore their 2-turn warning shadows!

environmentDescription: Bustling orchard juice-pressing shed with gleaming brass piston presses, wooden fruit troughs, and overhead conveyor belts.
rescueStory: Mochi slipped onto the sorting conveyor headed toward two rhythmic Sugar-Mill Piston Crushers—jam their gears before they Cycle!

mainObjective.summary: Hit the 2 Brass Crusher Gear-Switches 3 times each (6 hits total) with Special blasts and break 8 Iron Chains.

secondaryObjective.summary: Lose 0 Special Candies to Piston Crusher slams.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Columns 2 and 5 are Crusher Lanes that flash amber on Turn N and slam on Turn N+1!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Any Special Candy left sitting in Column 2 or 5 on a Slam beat gets flattened unless detonated or swapped out first!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances the conveyor belt 1 notch per move (26 moves max).

specialMechanics: Telegraphed Column Slam: firing a Striped or Wrapped blast INTO a flashing Crusher column jams that Piston UP for 3 turns and scores 1 Gear-Switch hit!
victoryCondition: Deliver 6 Special hits to the Crusher Gears and clear 8 Chains within 26 moves.
failureCondition: Conveyor reaches the active press after move 26.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Risk-reward columns: Columns 2 and 5 are where you MUST fire Specials, yet leaving an unpopped Special resting there for 1 turn gets it crushed!

environmentDescription: Outdoor orchard jaggery kitchen where giant copper cauldrons bubble with golden syrup beneath a three-span bamboo suspension bridge.
rescueStory: Both a Caramel Salamander and a Slime Blob are sabotaging Mochi's suspension bridge from opposite ends—fire AND slime collide on one board!

mainObjective.summary: Extinguish 8 Fire Barriers, wash 8 Sticky Slimes, and build 4 Bridge Spans (36 Litchi/Jackfruit candies).

secondaryObjective.summary: Trigger 3 'Steam Burst' reactions by matching Coconut/Kulfi directly between adjacent Fire and Slime tiles.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; matching cooling candies adjacent to BOTH Fire and Slime triggers a harmless Steam Pop clearing a 3x3 diamond!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Left half starts with Fire Barriers; Right half starts with Sticky Slime!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances caramel heat at 1.9%/sec while Slime slows bridge assembly.

specialMechanics: Elemental Steam Alchemy: letting Fire and Slime meet near a Coconut/Jamun match vaporizes both hazards in a joyful 3x3 steam cloud!
victoryCondition: Clear all Fire & Slime quotas and finish all 4 Bridge Spans before cauldron boil-over.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Opposing hazards (`Fire` vs `Slime`) can be intentionally steered together to trigger beneficial 3x3 Steam Burst board clears!

environmentDescription: Where the Dinajpur orchard canal meets a wide river confluence—an oversized brass-and-wood mechanical Crab-Submarine surfaces, clamping Mochi's dock!
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 2! Captain Clamp's Brass Crab-Sub has locked both mechanical pincers onto Mochi's river-pier while launching Glider drones overhead!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock both Claw Brass Trunks (cols 1 & 6), drop 2 Dock Release Keys, and deplete Captain Clamp's 160 HP hull.

secondaryObjective.summary: Unlock both Claw Trunks within the first 30 seconds.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Boss hull takes 50% reduced damage until BOTH Claw Brass Trunks are color-unlocked!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Claw Trunks at (3,1) and (3,6); Phase 2 summons Canopy Gliders attempting to lift your 2 Dock Keys.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Boss winching Mochi's pier closer at 1.55%/sec while deploying Glider drones and Mud bubbles.

specialMechanics: Shielded Periscope Core: popping all 3 fruit-clasps on BOTH Claw Trunks drops the Crab-Sub's periscope shield, exposing it to 2x Special Candy combo damage!
victoryCondition: Unlock both Claw Trunks, drop 2 Keys, and reduce Boss HP to 0 before pier crush.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Two-step armor puzzle: color-matching Brass Trunks disables the Boss's mechanical pincers first so explosive combos deal massive hull damage in Phase 2!

environmentDescription: Warm golden twilight at a bustling Padma riverfront candy bazaar with painted wooden sampan boats, striped awnings, and glowing paper lanterns.
rescueStory: Mochi hops aboard a painted country-boat ferry to reach the Sweet Market pier, but river currents gently tug the boat backward unless you row with matches!

mainObjective.summary: Row Mochi's Country-Boat Ferry 100m across the channel by matching 40 Coconut/Jamun river candies and clearing 6 Bamboo Cages.

secondaryObjective.summary: Detonate 3 Golden Syrup Jilapi Coils to light the bazaar pier lanterns.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board introducing `CANDY_CRISPY_JILAPI` relay coils pre-placed in the corners!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Ferry drifts back 4m every turn you don't match Blue/Purple river candies, but leaps +12m on combos!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Calm Chapter-5 breather (28 moves): Serpent waits at the departure bank if Ferry drifts all the way back to 0m.

specialMechanics: Jilapi Ring Relay: hitting any pre-placed `CANDY_CRISPY_JILAPI` coil with a Striped laser emits an 8-tile ring burst that surges the Ferry +20m forward!
victoryCondition: Reach 100m Ferry progress and clear 6 Cages within 28 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out or Ferry drifts back to 0m departure bank.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Tug-of-war river ferry propulsion boosted by Jilapi spiral relay nodes on the board!

environmentDescription: Colourful sweet-stall alley stacked with clay handi pots of snowy Rasgullas beneath striped bazaar canopies.
rescueStory: Falling wooden crates from an overloaded pushcart are tumbling down the bazaar steps—Mochi needs bouncy Rasgulla cushions to hop safely across!

mainObjective.summary: Collect 25 Spongy Rasgulla Orbs, unlock 2 Brass Sweet Trunks, and clear 8 Ice-chilled pots.

secondaryObjective.summary: Combine 2 Special Candies together twice.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board featuring `CANDY_SPONGY_RASGULLA`; every 5 Rasgullas collected inflates 1 safety bounce-awning in the arena!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 2 Brass Trunks sit in isolated side pockets reachable via Striped beams or Prism Teleporter!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Tries to gobble Rasgulla Orbs off the board every 3 turns!

specialMechanics: Isolated Pocket Geometry: side-alcove Trunks reward aligned row matches or warping a Striped Candy into the alcove using Prism Teleporter!
victoryCondition: Collect 25 Rasgullas, open both Trunks, and clear 8 Ice tiles within 27 moves.
failureCondition: Moves reach 0 before awning path completes.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Side-alcove board pockets challenge players to snipe horizontally across gaps while racing Golla-Gulp for Rasgulla orbs.

environmentDescription: A steep cobblestone spice-and-candy lane winding up toward the town clocktower.
rescueStory: Meet the Armored Jawbreaker Pangolin! It curls into an unstoppable rainbow ball down the cobblestone lane, then uncurls to catch its breath!

mainObjective.summary: Drain 65 Bazaar Marbles and break 10 Wrought Metal Chains while knocking back the Jawbreaker Pangolin during its uncurled window.

secondaryObjective.summary: Deal 3 Special Candy hits ONLY while the Pangolin is uncurled.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; players craft and hold Striped/Wrapped specials during the 2-turn Curled Roll, then detonate them during the 2-turn Uncurled Stance!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Sliding Terracotta Partition on row 3 + Chained candies guarding drain cols 0–1 and 6–7.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Alternates every 6 seconds between Curled Charge (immune to knockback!) and Uncurled Breather (takes 3x knockback!).

specialMechanics: Burst-Window Discipline: firing combos while the Pangolin is curled wastes knockback, whereas waiting for its uncurled dizzy icon sends it rolling 25% backward uphill!
victoryCondition: Drain 65 Marbles and break 10 Chains before the Pangolin reaches Mochi.
failureCondition: Pangolin collides with Mochi at 100% danger.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Introduces armored stance-switching: teaches players to stockpile Special Candies on the board and unleash them in synchronized burst windows!

environmentDescription: Grand riverfront sugar-granary gatehouse with a massive bronze counterweight shutter slowly ratcheting downward.
rescueStory: The bazaar curfew bell rang! The heavy Bronze Sluice Shutter starts WIDE OPEN and is steadily closing—Mochi must sprint down the aisle before it seals!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Timed Blast Shutter >= 35% open while dropping 3 Granary Keys to sprint Mochi through the doorway!

secondaryObjective.summary: Escape while the Shutter is still >= 70% open for 3 Stars.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; matching Litchi or Jilapi candies cranks the counterweight chains UP (+8% shutter height per match)!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Shutter starts at 100% open and drops 3.2%/sec; 1 central Piston Crusher guards Column 4.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Glider swoops to tug Keys upward while the Shutter ratchets down toward 0%!

specialMechanics: Inverted Gate Tension: instead of opening a closed gate, you are holding a closing door open with one hand (Litchi matches) while dropping Keys with the other!
victoryCondition: Drop all 3 Granary Keys while the Timed Blast Shutter is >= 35% open.
failureCondition: Shutter slams completely shut (0% open) before Mochi exits.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Inverts the classic gate formula—the exit starts open and is actively closing, demanding dual focus on counterweight cranking and key dropping!

environmentDescription: Illuminated riverfront festival pier where three moving ferry pontoons form a shifting bridge toward a grand riverboat steamer.
rescueStory: Chapter 5 Finale! Mochi must hop across three Moving Ferry Pontoons while a Caramel Salamander, Jawbreaker Pangolin, and Closing Gangway Shutter converge!

mainObjective.summary: Align 3 Ferry Pontoons (45 River Candies), extinguish 8 Fire Embers, and detonate 5 Special Candies before the steamer gangway closes!

secondaryObjective.summary: Chain 2 Jilapi Ring Relays in a single turn.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color market board (Mango, Litchi, Guava, Coconut, Jamun, Jilapi specials); Resin Anchor can lock aligned pontoons in place!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Pontoons align at 15, 30, and 45 river-candy milestones while Fire Barriers nibble from row 6 upward.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Sparks embers on row 6 while steamer gangway timer ticks at 1.75%/sec.

specialMechanics: Milestone Lock-In: each time Mochi hops onto the next Ferry Pontoon, a fireworks burst clears the bottom row of Fire Embers automatically!
victoryCondition: Complete all 3 Pontoon milestones, clear 8 Embers, and trigger 5 Specials before gangway lift.
failureCondition: Steamer gangway closes (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: Three-stage milestone checkpoints where each Mochi hop triggers a celebratory board-wide bottom-row ember sweep!

environmentDescription: Crystal-turquoise coral cove inspired by St. Martin's Island, framed by swaying coconut palms, white shell sandbars, and driftwood cabanas.
rescueStory: Mochi lands on a sunny coral sandbar, but her beach-cabana bridge lock sits around a solid coral corner—bank Striped lasers off angled Coconut Husk Bumpers to hit it!

mainObjective.summary: Crack 4 Armored Coconut Husk Bumpers (12 hits) and pop 3 Corner Coral Locks using deflected Striped lasers.

secondaryObjective.summary: Hit 2 Coral Locks in a single turn via a double-bumper ricochet.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color tropical board (Coconut, Mango, Mandarin, Guava, Litchi); firing a vertical Striped beam into a 45° Coconut Bumper bends the laser 90° horizontally into the side alcove!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 4 Coconut Bumpers placed at (1,2), (1,5), (5,2), and (5,5) form a rectangular laser mirror circuit.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Sunny island breather pace (30 moves, turn-based): Serpent sunbathes along the outer reef track.

specialMechanics: 90-Degree Laser Billiards: angled Pearl-Shell Coconut Bumpers turn vertical Striped Candies into horizontal L-beams (and vice versa)!
victoryCondition: Pop all 3 Corner Coral Locks and crack 4 Coconut Bumpers within 30 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out before reef bridge drops.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Billiard-style 90-degree laser reflection lets players snipe tucked-away locks around indestructible coral walls!

environmentDescription: Stepped coral-limestone tidepools sparkling under tropical sun with bamboo stepping posts.
rescueStory: Twin Gur-Slime Blobs are oozing across the tidepool stepping posts while Coconut Husk Bumpers guard the lagoon drains!

mainObjective.summary: Wash away 14 Sticky Slime tiles and drain 65 Lagoon Marbles to raise the driftwood causeway.

secondaryObjective.summary: Trigger 4 Wrapped Tender Coconut splash bursts.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Tender Coconut Wrapped bursts cleanse Slime in a plus-shaped hydro cross.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Coconut Bumpers shield drain cols 0 and 7 until cracked or bypassed via reflected beams.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances at 1.8%/sec and coats 2 candies in Slime every 8s.

specialMechanics: Hydro Ricochet: banking a Blue/Coconut Striped beam off a Coconut Bumper upgrades the reflected beam into a Pressurized Hydro Jet that strips ALL Slime along its row!
victoryCondition: Clean 14 Slimes and drain 65 Lagoon Marbles before Slime Blobs coat Mochi's post.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Elemental beam upgrade: reflecting a Coconut-colored Striped laser off a Coconut Bumper turns it into a Slime-erasing Hydro Jet!

environmentDescription: Sloping palm-lined white-sand beach boardwalk dotted with springy Rasgulla beach-umbrellas and giant coconut bumpers.
rescueStory: A Spiked Jawbreaker Boulder AND an Armored Jawbreaker Pangolin are rolling down the boardwalk ramp behind Mochi—bounce them back!

mainObjective.summary: Collect 28 Spongy Rasgulla Orbs, drop 2 Cabana Keys, and shatter the Spiked Boulder (3 Special hits).

secondaryObjective.summary: Bounce the rolling hazard backward twice using Rasgulla cushions.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color island board including `CANDY_SPONGY_RASGULLA`; every 14 Rasgullas collected deploys an automatic Bounce Cushion behind Mochi!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Keys navigate through staggered Coconut Bumpers and Crumbling Sand-Wafer tiles.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Rolls down the boardwalk at 1.95%/sec alongside the Spiked Jawbreaker.

specialMechanics: Pinball Cushion Rebound: when the Pangolin hits a deployed Rasgulla Cushion, it rebounds into the Spiked Boulder behind it, dealing 1 free Special hit to the boulder!
victoryCondition: Collect 28 Rasgullas, drop 2 Keys, and shatter the Spiked Boulder before boardwalk impact.
failureCondition: Boulder or Pangolin reaches Mochi at 100% danger.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Arena pinball physics: bouncing the lead Pangolin makes it collide with the trailing Spiked Boulder for chain-reaction damage!

environmentDescription: A narrow twin-lagoon sandbar swept by brisk sea breezes, linking two coral lighthouses with a wooden zip-trolley.
rescueStory: Brisk island crosswinds are shifting candies sideways while a Closing Lighthouse Door slowly descends ahead of Mochi's zip-trolley!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Lighthouse Shutter >= 40% open, unlock 2 Brass Signal Trunks, and break 10 Iron Chains.

secondaryObjective.summary: Unlock both Signal Trunks with 7+ moves to spare.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; Row 1 blows LEFT while Row 5 blows RIGHT (`OBS_GALE_WIND_TUNNEL` counter-currents)!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Counter-rotating wind belts on rows 1 and 5 circulate candies around the 2 central Brass Signal Trunks!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Rides the wind belts in hybrid mode (25 moves / 70s) to re-chain unlocked tiles.

specialMechanics: Counter-Current Carousel: candies ride Row 1 left and Row 5 right, automatically bringing needed fruit colors into alignment with the central Brass Trunks!
victoryCondition: Open both Brass Trunks and break 10 Chains while keeping Lighthouse Shutter >= 40% open.
failureCondition: Shutter closes below 40% at move 25 or timer expiry.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Opposing left/right wind conveyor rows create a circular candy carousel around stationary color-locked chests!

environmentDescription: A flamboyant floating sweet-banquet barge anchored in a coral bay, captained by the gigantic Maharaja Gulp!
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 3! Maharaja Gulp activates his vacuum-slurp horn, pulling whole rows of island candies—and Mochi's raft!—toward his banquet barge!

mainObjective.summary: Deplete Maharaja Gulp's 200 HP appetite bar by banking lasers off 4 Coconut Bumpers and feeding 5 Special Candies into his Mega-Slurp beam!

secondaryObjective.summary: Feed a Rainbow Color Bomb directly into a Mega-Slurp beam for an instant 60-HP Fizzy Overload!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color island board; every 3 turns Maharaja Gulp highlights 2 columns with a golden Vacuum Beam—any Special Candy left inside those columns gets slurped for 40 Boss stun damage!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 4 angled Coconut Bumpers allow horizontal sniping into Gulp's flank shield during non-slurp turns.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Boss pulling Mochi's raft closer at 1.55%/sec with periodic 2-column Mega-Slurps.

specialMechanics: Trojan-Candy Counterattack: instead of detonating every Special immediately, parking Specials inside Maharaja Gulp's telegraphed Vacuum Columns turns his own attack against him!
victoryCondition: Reduce Maharaja Gulp's 200 HP to 0 and land 5 Fizzy Slurp counters before Mochi's raft hits the barge.
failureCondition: Raft pulled into banquet barge (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: Inverts normal match-3 habits: you intentionally LEAVE Special Candies unpopped in telegraphed boss columns so the boss swallows them for massive stun damage!

environmentDescription: Rain-kissed Meghna riverbank embankment with blooming pink shapla (water-lilies), floating origami paper boats, and brass drainage pumps.
rescueStory: Monsoon rains have submerged the bottom 3 rows of the puzzle board in crystal river water—making submerged candies float UPWARD instead of falling down!

mainObjective.summary: Collect 36 Buoyant Barisal Guavas and 24 Monsoon Jamuns while mastering the Dual-Gravity Flood Line!

secondaryObjective.summary: Form 4 matches right across the Row-3 Waterline Equator.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color monsoon board introducing `OBS_MONSOON_FLOOD_TIDE`: Rows 0–3 fall DOWN toward Row 3, while submerged Rows 4–6 float UP toward Row 4!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Rows 4, 5, and 6 are underwater; candies spawn from BOTH row 0 (sky) and row 6 (riverbed) and meet in the middle!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Gentle Chapter-7 onboarding pace (29 moves) as players enjoy learning dual-gravity cascades!

specialMechanics: Waterline Convergence: because top candies fall down and bottom candies float up, rows 3 and 4 become a super-dense cascade collision zone!
victoryCondition: Harvest 36 Guavas and 24 Jamuns within 29 moves.
failureCondition: Moves expire before Mochi's paper-boat dock rises.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Dual-gravity horizon: top half falls downward while submerged bottom half floats upward, colliding at the central waterline!

environmentDescription: Wide monsoon river channel crossed by a lantern-lit covered sampan boat amidst playful glowing turquoise whirlpools.
rescueStory: A Swirling River-Current Eel is spinning mini-whirlpools around Mochi's sampan—rotating 2x2 blocks of candies clockwise every 2 turns!

mainObjective.summary: Propel Mochi's Sampan 120m to the stone ghat and free 8 Chained Buoy-Candies.

secondaryObjective.summary: Let the Eel's clockwise 2x2 spin complete a 4+ match for you twice!

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board with submerged Rows 5–6; Guava matches calm the Eel's backward current tug.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Two glowing 2x2 Whirlpool rings at (2,1)-(3,2) and (2,5)-(3,6) rotate their 4 candies 90° clockwise every 2 moves.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Tugs ferry back 8m every 2 moves while rotating the whirlpool tiles.

specialMechanics: Predictive Spin Setup: setting 3 matching candies adjacent to a Whirlpool quadrant lets the Eel rotate the 4th candy into a free Striped/Rainbow match!
victoryCondition: Reach 120m Sampan distance and snap 8 Chains within 27 moves.
failureCondition: Moves reach 0 before docking.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Predictable clockwise 2x2 whirlpool tile rotations let clever players engineer hands-free end-of-turn combos!

environmentDescription: Submerged brick sluice-house where the escape keyholes are mounted at the WATERLINE in the middle of the board instead of the bottom!
rescueStory: The lower sluice chamber flooded! Because the Cork-Float Keys are buoyant in water, two Keys drop DOWN from the roof while two float UP from the floor toward Row 3!

mainObjective.summary: Deliver 2 Top Keys DOWN and 2 Submerged Cork-Keys UP into the central Row-3 Sluice Locks!

secondaryObjective.summary: Clear the stage without raising the flood gauge above 60%.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color board; Top Keys start at Row 0 (cols 1, 6) falling down; Bottom Cork-Keys start at Row 6 (cols 2, 5) floating UP toward Row 3!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Row 3 holds 4 Sluice Lock receptacles guarded by 2-HP Bamboo Cages.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Stalks along the upper sluice catwalk at 1.8%/sec.

specialMechanics: Bidirectional Key Extraction: for the first time ever, Keys converge from BOTH top and bottom toward the middle row of the grid!
victoryCondition: Seat all 4 Keys into the Row-3 Sluice Locks before the Stilt Crawler reaches Mochi.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Center-row Key exits fed simultaneously by downward gravity from above and upward buoyancy from below!

environmentDescription: Twilight monsoon levee shrouded in rain-mist, illuminated only by warm mason-jar firefly lanterns along a collapsing plank bridge.
rescueStory: Rain-mist hides the puzzle board while rising floodwater pushes Mochi's plank bridge upward against sharp overhead beams—drain the sluice fast!

mainObjective.summary: Clear 12 Rain-Mist Clouds, lower Floodwater by draining 70 Sluice Marbles, and repair 4 Bridge Planks.

secondaryObjective.summary: Trigger a Rainbow + Striped combo to light all levee lanterns at once.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color monsoon board; warning—using `TOOL_MONSOON_WATER_BLASTER` here adds +5% floodwater height, so prefer Gust Fan or Firefly Beacon!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Every 25 Sluice Marbles drained lowers the submerged water level by 1 full board row, restoring normal gravity!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Raises flood pressure at 1.9%/sec while spinning misted tiles.

specialMechanics: Dynamic Receding Waterline: as you drain Sluice Marbles (25 -> 50 -> 70), the floodwater visibly drops row-by-row on the 3D board!
victoryCondition: Clear 12 Mist Clouds, drain 70 Marbles, and rebuild 4 Planks before flood surge hits 100%.
failureCondition: Flood gauge reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Board physics evolve mid-level: draining marbles physically lowers the waterline row-by-row, flipping submerged rows back to normal downward gravity!

environmentDescription: Monumental brick-and-brass river barrage spanning surging turquoise waters with three giant counterweight floodgates.
rescueStory: Chapter 7 Finale! Mochi must cross the Great Barrage catwalk by cranking three Floodgates while Whirlpool Eels, Rotating Turbines, and Rising Tides test every river skill!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock 3 Brass Turbine Trunks, crank the Timed Flood Shutter >= 50%, and detonate 6 Special Candies.

secondaryObjective.summary: Finish with 6+ moves remaining.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board combining 2 Rotating Turbine Gates, submerged rows 5–6, and 3 Brass Turbine Trunks.

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Hybrid turn + tide challenge; Riverboat Winch tool instantly boosts Shutter by +25%.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Hybrid pressure (26 moves / 72s) with 2x2 whirlpool spins.

specialMechanics: Hydro-Turbine Overdrive: firing a Striped blast through an open Rotating Turbine Gate spins the generator to crank +20% Shutter height at once!
victoryCondition: Open all 3 Brass Trunks and trigger 6 Specials with Flood Shutter >= 50%.
failureCondition: Out of moves or Flood Shutter seals shut.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Threading Striped lasers through open Rotating Turbine paddles supercharges the mechanical escape gate!

environmentDescription: Crisp sunlit Himalayan foothills with pine groves, stone viaduct arches, and a cheerful miniature blue steam-train waiting on a frosted siding.
rescueStory: Welcome to the Foothills! A Foothill Snow-Kulfi Golem is icing the miniature steam-train switch while a Prism Chameleon shifts colors on a pine branch!

mainObjective.summary: Shatter 12 Himalayan Frost Ice blocks and land 4 Color-Matched strikes on the Prism Chameleon to clear the train switch!

secondaryObjective.summary: Detonate 2 Golden Jilapi Coils to melt surrounding Ice in 1 hit.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color alpine board (Mandarin, Litchi, Mango, Jamun, Kulfi); `ENEMY_FROST_YETI_GOLEM` is IMMUNE to Freeze Blast—match warm Mandarin/Litchi/Jilapi pieces instead!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 12 2-HP Frost Ice blocks encase the switch tracks; Jilapi ring-pulses melt 2 HP of Ice instantly!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Chapter-8 breather pace (29 moves): shifts its crest badge to a random board color each turn.

specialMechanics: Chameleon Color-Sync: matching the exact fruit color displayed on the Chameleon's crest fires a targeted beam that pushes both foothill creatures back!
victoryCondition: Clear 12 Frost Ice blocks and score 4 Color-Matched Chameleon hits within 29 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out before toy-train switch clears.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Color-reactive enemy targeting: watching the Chameleon's live crest color tells you which candy color deals knockback on that turn!

environmentDescription: Resonant mountain railway tunnel lined with glittering amber rock-sugar veins and wooden support beams.
rescueStory: Careful with loud blasts! In this echoing tunnel, heavy 3x3 Bombs shake loose Falling Sugar-Shale pebbles from the ceiling—precision Striped lasers are king!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 3 Railway Lantern Keys and clear 10 Frost Ice tiles without burying the chutes in Shale Rockfall!

secondaryObjective.summary: Win while triggering <= 2 Rockfall tremors.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color foothill board introducing `OBS_LOOSE_SHALE_ROCKFALL`; Striped Candies cut cleanly with ZERO tremor, whereas Wrapped/Cluster Bombs shake down 2 top-row Shale Pebbles!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Keys start at row 1; reckless bombing drops Shale Pebbles right on top of your Keys!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances along the tunnel siding at 1.75%/sec and exhales frost every 10s.

specialMechanics: Surgical Laser Discipline: rewards 4-in-a-row Striped Candies and Prism Teleporter finesse over noisy area-of-effect bombs!
victoryCondition: Deliver all 3 Lantern Keys and clear 10 Frost Ice tiles before the Yeti blocks the tunnel.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Seismic noise mechanic: explosive 3x3 bombs trigger ceiling rockfalls, elevating clean 4-match Striped surgery over brute blast spam!

environmentDescription: Breathtaking high-altitude ropeway cable car suspended between two snow-dusted mandarin ridges.
rescueStory: Mochi's bright red cable car stalled mid-gorge! High ridge gusts blow candies diagonally while a Clockwork Sentinel cranks a Piston Press on the tower!

mainObjective.summary: Jam 2 Tower Piston Crushers (6 hits), break 10 Iron Chains, and drain 65 Gorge Marbles to winch Mochi's cable car to the summit.

secondaryObjective.summary: Craft 2 Rainbow Color Bombs during the climb.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; unlocks `TOOL_SYRUP_CONDUIT_BRUSH` reward upon completion!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Wind shifts Row 3 rightward toward Crusher Column 5—careful not to let your Striped Candy drift under a slamming piston!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Turn-based precision challenge (26 moves): chains 2 tiles every 4th move.

specialMechanics: Wind-Assisted Crusher Jam: letting the Row-3 wind drift slide a Striped Candy INTO Column 5 on the Piston's telegraph turn auto-fires it to jam the press!
victoryCondition: Jam both Crushers (6 hits), snap 10 Chains, and drain 65 Marbles in 26 moves.
failureCondition: Moves run out mid-gorge.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Combining Wind Drift with Piston Timing: drifting a Special into a telegraphing Crusher lane jams the hazard hands-free!

environmentDescription: Dramatic mountain pass where a steaming hot-spring caramel flume meets an icy glacier ledge beneath a twin-arch bridge.
rescueStory: Fire and Ice! A Snow-Kulfi Golem stomps down the left ice ledge while a Sizzling Caramel Salamander races up the right hot-spring trench!

mainObjective.summary: Clear 10 Glacier Ice blocks, extinguish 10 Fire Embers, and unlock 2 Summit Brass Trunks.

secondaryObjective.summary: Bank 3 Striped lasers from the warm right half into the icy left half via Coconut Bumpers.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; Left cols 0–3 spawn chilly Ice; Right cols 4–7 spawn hot Fire Embers; 2 Coconut Bumpers route beams across the thermal divide!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Cross-routing warm beams left melts 2-HP Ice instantly; cross-routing cool Coconut beams right douses entire Ember rows!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Dual elemental advance at 1.9%/sec unless cross-countered.

specialMechanics: Cross-Hemisphere Elemental Routing: each half of the board holds the exact elemental counter needed to clear the opposite half twice as fast!
victoryCondition: Clear 10 Ice, 10 Fire, and both Brass Trunks before either creature reaches the bridge.
failureCondition: Thermal danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Asymmetric Fire-and-Ice board halves where cross-shooting lasers across the center divider deals 2x elemental weakness clears!

environmentDescription: High alpine observatory viaduct overlooking sunlit snow peaks, where the towering Kanchen-Frost Yeti Colossus blocks the mountain express!
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 4! Kanchen-Frost freezes the outer puzzle columns and hurls twin Spiked Jawbreakers down the viaduct—use Rasgulla Trampolines to bounce his boulders right back into his ice armor!

mainObjective.summary: Shatter Kanchen-Frost's 240 HP Glacier Armor by rebounding 3 Boulders (via Rasgulla Orbs) and detonating 4 Warm Jilapi/Special combos!

secondaryObjective.summary: Defeat Kanchen-Frost with > 40% viaduct safety margin.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color alpine board featuring `CANDY_SPONGY_RASGULLA` and `CANDY_CRISPY_JILAPI`; Boss is immune to Cryo tools—warm combos & boulder rebounds deal huge damage!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Phase 1 freezes cols 0 & 7; Phase 2 adds Foothill Wind gusts and twin boulders.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Colossus stomping at 1.6%/sec with Frost Breath & Boulder Hurls.

specialMechanics: Avalanche Counter-Volley: collecting 10 Rasgulla Orbs deploys a Spring Bumper on the viaduct that launches Kanchen-Frost's next boulder straight back for 50 Armor Damage!
victoryCondition: Reduce Kanchen-Frost's 240 HP to 0 via 3 Boulder Rebounds and 4 Warm Combos.
failureCondition: Viaduct crushed at 100% danger.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Boss is immune to Freeze tools—instead you harvest Rasgulla sponge candies to volley his own giant jawbreakers back at him!

environmentDescription: Joyful secular rural Fruit & Kite Carnival (Mela) decked with rainbow paper pinwheels, geometric painted borders, and fruit pavilions.
rescueStory: Welcome to the Harvest Carnival! Sparkling Refracting Quartz Prisms sit on the fairground board—hit one with a Striped laser and watch it split into FOUR beams!

mainObjective.summary: Fire 5 Prism-Split Laser Bursts to pop 14 Woven Bamboo Cages and unlock Mochi's Kite-Balloon tether!

secondaryObjective.summary: Chain both Quartz Prisms together in a single move!

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color festive board introducing `OBS_CRYSTAL_PRISM_MIRROR`: alternates each turn between Orthogonal (+) Cross-Split and Diagonal (X) Star-Split!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 2 Quartz Prisms at (3,2) and (3,5) amplify any Striped blast into multi-axis fireworks!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Festive Chapter-9 breather (28 moves): Golla-Gulp samples fairground fruits beside the stall.

specialMechanics: Orthogonal-vs-Diagonal Prism Alternation: on odd moves Prisms fire + cross beams; on even moves they fire X diagonal beams into the corners!
victoryCondition: Trigger 5 Prism-Split Bursts and break 14 Cages within 28 moves.
failureCondition: Moves expire before Kite-Balloon lifts off.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Alternating + and X Refracting Quartz Prisms turn single Striped matches into celebratory full-board geometric laser shows!

environmentDescription: High above the carnival grounds where colorful diamond paper kites (ghuri) carry basket bridges between two wooden fairground towers.
rescueStory: Three Canopy Gliders are tangling Mochi's kite-bridge strings while a Prism Chameleon camouflages on the tower flagpole!

mainObjective.summary: Drop 4 Kite-Spool Keys, score 4 Color-Matched Chameleon hits, and shatter 2 Honeycomb Seals.

secondaryObjective.summary: Drop 2 Keys on the exact same turn.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; firing a Striped beam of the Chameleon's active color through a Quartz Prism counts as a Double Critical Hit!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Central Quartz Prism at (3,3) sits right between the two Queen Honeycomb clusters.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Gliders swoop for Spool Keys while Chameleon stalks at 1.85%/sec.

specialMechanics: Prism Snipe: hitting the central Prism on an even (X-diagonal) beat snipes BOTH Queen Honeycomb cells in the top corners simultaneously!
victoryCondition: Deliver 4 Spool Keys, land 4 Chameleon hits, and clear 2 Honeycombs before tether snap.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Diagonal X-Prism geometry lets one well-timed center shot simultaneously snipe both corner Queen Honeycombs AND shoo Gliders!

environmentDescription: Hand-carved wooden village ferris wheel decked in marigold-colored ribbons and spinning fruit gondolas.
rescueStory: Mochi is riding Gondola #1 up to the top exit deck, but four Rotating Pinwheel Gates and a Sliding Terracotta Bar keep rearranging the chutes!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock 3 Brass Gondola Trunks and drain 75 Carnival Marbles within 25 strategic moves.

secondaryObjective.summary: Drain 25+ Marbles in a single cascade turn.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; pure turn-based masterwork combining 4 Rotating Gates + 1 Sliding Partition + 1 Quartz Prism!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Zero real-time stress—every single board mechanism moves deterministically on your swipe!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Advances 1 ferris-spoke per move (25 moves total).

specialMechanics: Deterministic Clockwork Symphony: clamping the open state with `TOOL_JACKFRUIT_RESIN_ANCHOR` lets a single Prism-Rainbow cascade drain 30+ Marbles!
victoryCondition: Open 3 Brass Trunks and drain 75 Marbles within 25 moves.
failureCondition: Clockwork Sentinel locks the wheel on move 25.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Grand clockwork puzzle box—every gate, slider, prism, and sentinel moves on exact deterministic turn beats with zero RNG timer panic!

environmentDescription: Festive twilight sweet-arcade Pavilion with sizzling Jilapi skillets, bouncing Rasgulla trampolines, and a Descending Stage Curtain!
rescueStory: The carnival finale curtain is lowering while a Jawbreaker Pangolin and Molten Salamander put on an unruly pyrotechnic show along Mochi's stage!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Stage Shutter >= 45% open, trigger 6 Jilapi Ring Relays, and extinguish 12 Fire Embers!

secondaryObjective.summary: Finish with Stage Shutter >= 80% open!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; 4 respawning Jilapi Relay pedestals amplify Prism-split lasers into massive overlapping ring bursts!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Prism at (3,4) feeds directly into 4 corner Jilapi Relays on even (X-diagonal) moves!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: High-tempo carnival rush at 1.95%/sec alongside spreading Fire Embers.

specialMechanics: Diagonal Prism-to-Jilapi Supernova: hitting the center Prism on an X-turn triggers ALL FOUR corner Jilapi Coils at once, cranking the Stage Curtain +35% open!
victoryCondition: Trigger 6 Jilapi Relays and douse 12 Embers while keeping Stage Shutter >= 45% open.
failureCondition: Curtain slams shut or Pangolin catches Mochi.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Center X-Prism wired to four corner Jilapi Coils rewards timing a single shot for a quadruple chain detonation!

environmentDescription: Centerpiece Brass Clockwork Carousel Pavilion towering above the fruit festival with giant spinning gears and confetti cannons.
rescueStory: BOSS ENCOUNTER 5! Charkha-Bot, the giant brass carnival automaton, has gone haywire—synchronizing two Piston Crushers and a Countdown Shutter to block Mochi's balloon!

mainObjective.summary: Overload Charkha-Bot's 260 HP dynamo using 4 Double-Special Combos while jamming 2 Piston Crushers and keeping the Escape Shutter >= 40%!

secondaryObjective.summary: Defeat Charkha-Bot within 22 moves!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board; Hybrid Boss (26 moves / 75s)—combining two adjacent Specials (e.g. Striped + Wrapped) short-circuits Charkha-Bot for 65 HP!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: 2 Quartz Prisms help clear chains quickly so you can pair adjacent Specials via Saffron Brush or Prism Teleporter!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 2-Phase Clockwork Boss advancing on both move ticks and shutter countdown.

specialMechanics: Dynamo Short-Circuit: single matches tickle its brass armor, whereas swapping ANY two Special Candies together unleashes an overload arc for massive damage + 2-turn stun!
victoryCondition: Deplete 260 Boss HP and execute 4 Double-Special Combos with Shutter >= 40%.
failureCondition: Moves hit 0 or Escape Shutter closes.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Pure combo-crafting boss test: rewards pairing two Special Candies side-by-side to short-circuit heavy clockwork armor!

environmentDescription: Luminous subterranean jungle cavern inspired by Meghalaya & Bandarban hills, spanned by woven living-root bridges glowing with amethyst and quartz crystals.
rescueStory: Final Chapter! A Faceted Crystal Sentinel hovers before the Living-Root Bridge—its front mirror blocks vertical shots, so bank lasers into its unshielded flanks!

mainObjective.summary: Land 5 Side-Flank Laser Hits on the Crystal Sentinel (via Bumpers/Prisms) and collect 36 Tender Coconuts to hydrate the living-root bridge.

secondaryObjective.summary: Avoid firing vertical beams into the Sentinel's front mirror shield.

candyMatchingRequirement: 5-color crystal cavern board introducing `ENEMY_QUARTZ_WARDEN`—immune from below, 100% vulnerable to horizontal beams bent off Coconut Bumpers or + Prisms!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Coconut Bumpers on cols 0 & 7 bend vertical Striped shots horizontally right into the Warden's left/right core!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Chapter-10 tactical opener (28 moves): advances 1 root-knot per move.

specialMechanics: Flank-Only Geometry: teaches directional shield routing—vertical beams in cols 3–4 bounce off harmlessly, whereas outer-column bank shots pierce straight through!
victoryCondition: Deliver 5 Side-Flank Laser Hits and collect 36 Coconuts within 28 moves.
failureCondition: Sentinel reaches Mochi's root arch after move 28.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Directional boss-lite shield puzzle: frontal vertical attacks fail, requiring 90-degree lateral bank shots via side bumpers!

environmentDescription: Sparkling underground emerald waterfall feeding a crystal-clear cavern pool where submerged crystal rows meet refracting prisms!
rescueStory: Dual-gravity crystal waters submerge the lower cavern while BOTH a Crystal Sentinel and Whirlpool Eel guard the waterfall elevator!

mainObjective.summary: Converge 4 Crystal Elevator Keys (2 top-down, 2 bottom-up) to Row 3 and land 4 Flank Hits on the Crystal Sentinel!

secondaryObjective.summary: Let the Eel spin a Striped Candy into alignment with a Quartz Prism.

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color cavern board combining Dual-Gravity `OBS_MONSOON_FLOOD_TIDE` (rows 4–6) with Row-3 `OBS_CRYSTAL_PRISM_MIRROR` nodes!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Row 3 hosts both the 4 Key Receptacles AND 2 Quartz Prisms!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Real-time cavern advance at 1.85%/sec with Eel whirlpool spins.

specialMechanics: Waterline Prism Nexus: because cascades from BOTH top and bottom collide at Row 3, the Row-3 Quartz Prisms trigger chain-split beams nearly every cascade!
victoryCondition: Seat all 4 Elevator Keys at Row 3 and land 4 Sentinel Flank Hits before capture.
failureCondition: Danger reaches 100%.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Placing Refracting Prisms right on the Dual-Gravity Waterline creates spectacular self-sustaining cascade fireworks!

environmentDescription: A vaulted octagonal mineral chamber lit by shifting rainbow shafts, housing three ancient secular Brass Explorer Trunks.
rescueStory: Two Twin Prism Chameleons guard the Explorer Vault while fragile Crystal Shale hangs overhead—use clean laser surgical precision to unlock all three Trunks!

mainObjective.summary: Unlock 3 Brass Explorer Trunks, land 6 Color-Synced Chameleon Hits, and clear 10 Glacier Crystal seals in 25 moves!

secondaryObjective.summary: Complete with 0 Shale Rockfall tremors triggered!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color board with `OBS_LOOSE_SHALE_ROCKFALL`—avoid 3x3 Bombs; use Striped + Prism + Saffron Color Brush!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Octagonal board (4 corners cut) with central X/+ Prism routing color matches to all 3 Brass Trunks.

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Turn-based precision test (25 moves): Twin Chameleons display 2 target colors each turn.

specialMechanics: Dual-Spectrum Sync: matching a color shared by BOTH a Brass Trunk clasp AND a Chameleon crest simultaneously unlocks the chest AND stuns the stalker!
victoryCondition: Open all 3 Explorer Trunks, score 6 Chameleon hits, and clear 10 Crystal Ice seals in 25 moves.
failureCondition: Moves reach 0 inside the vault.
uniqueGameplayTwist: High-IQ surgical puzzle combining seismic bomb restrictions with overlapping Trunk-and-Chameleon color targeting!

environmentDescription: A soaring crystal-arched suspension causeway leading directly to the Grand Sanctuary Gates above a glowing caramel-and-waterfall chasm.
rescueStory: Penultimate Survival Gauntlet! The Emerald Serpent, Crystal Sentinel, AND Closing Sanctuary Gate converge as Mochi makes her final dash to the Sanctum!

mainObjective.summary: Keep the Sanctuary Shutter >= 45% open, drop 3 Royal Sanctum Keys, drain 80 Crystal Marbles, and land 4 Flank Hits!

secondaryObjective.summary: Escape with Danger below 50% and Shutter >= 75%!

candyMatchingRequirement: 6-color full-arsenal board featuring Prisms, Coconut Bumpers, Rotating Gates, and Jilapi Relays!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Every system learned across Chapters 1–10 works in harmony to generate huge cascade chains!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: Elite Serpent + Sentinel pursuit at 2.0%/sec.

specialMechanics: Full-Arsenal Harmonic Chain: banking a Striped shot off a Coconut Bumper into a Quartz Prism triggers Jilapi Relays that simultaneously drain Marbles, flank the Sentinel, and crank the Shutter!
victoryCondition: Complete all 4 Causeway objectives while keeping Sanctuary Shutter >= 45% open.
failureCondition: Shutter closes or Serpent catches Mochi.
uniqueGameplayTwist: Rube-Goldberg laser circuit where one well-aimed bank shot chains Bumper -> Prism -> Jilapi Coil to advance all 4 objectives at once!

levelName: FINAL BOSS: Emperor Chroma-Fang's Prism Sanctum
environmentDescription: Breathtaking sunlit Crystal Jungle Amphitheater crowned by a rainbow waterfall terrace, living-root arches, and the Grand Golden Rescue Portal!
rescueStory: GRAND CAMPAIGN FINALE (Level 56)! Emperor Chroma-Fang—the Three-Headed Prism Serpent (Ruby Fire Head, Sapphire Frost Head, Emerald Slime Head)—blocks the Golden Portal in an epic 3-Phase showdown!

mainObjective.summary: Vanquish Emperor Chroma-Fang's 350 HP across 3 Phases: (1) Counter Fire/Ice/Slime Heads, (2) Route Dual-Gravity Prism Beams, and (3) Drop the Final Royal Key + Fire the 100% Rainbow Mega-Cannon!

secondaryObjective.summary: Land a Rainbow Bomb + Striped Candy mega-combo through a Quartz Prism to hit all 3 Serpent Heads simultaneously!

candyMatchingRequirement: Full 6-color Grand Finale palette (Himsagar Mango, Dinajpur Litchi, Tender Coconut, Monsoon Jamun, Pistachio Kulfi, Crispy Jilapi)!

survivalObstacle.layoutNotes: Phase 1: Fire/Ice/Slime tri-hazards; Phase 2: Rows 5–6 submerge in Dual-Gravity Crystal Tide around 2 central Prisms; Phase 3: Spiral sprint for the Final Key!

enemyOrThreat.threatSummary: 3-Phase Ultimate Boss (350 HP) shifting arena physics at 65% and 30% HP thresholds!

specialMechanics: Tri-Elemental Prism Finale: routing a Rainbow + Striped combo into the central Quartz Prisms refracts elemental counter-beams into all 3 Hydra heads at once, charging the Golden Rescue Mega-Cannon!
victoryCondition: Deplete all 350 HP of Emperor Chroma-Fang, deliver the Final Royal Key, and fire the 100% Rainbow Mega-Cannon!
failureCondition: Chroma-Fang overtakes the Golden Portal terrace (Danger = 100%).
uniqueGameplayTwist: Three-stage evolving boss arena that synthesizes elemental counterplay, dual-gravity waterline cascades, and prism-refracted Rainbow mega-combos into one unforgettable climax!
